data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), ahead of picking targets with [Melancholic Miasma](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.plague-legion.melancholic-miasma).

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA NURGLE** unit of yours.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit has tested for [Battle-shock](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock) because of Melancholic Miasma, pick another enemy unit up to 9" from the unit, which then has to test for Battle-shock too, for the rest of the phase.
